title: LandTek survey tie point
description: One DENR-LMB survey tie point. Coordinates are reference grade (provenance_level 'inferred_strong'), never a certified monument description.

gp_id.description: Geoportal Lot Plotter record id. Stable primary key upstream.

pointref.description: Monument reference exactly as published. Never edited.

lgu.description: Canonical LGU name. Empty where the source locality is not an LGU.

psgc_code.description: PSA PSGC code for the LGU. Empty where unresolved.

source_locality.description: Locality string as the source published it.

municipality.description: Title-cased source locality. Display convenience only.

province_psgc.description: PSA PSGC code for the province.

mon_no.description: Monument number or name, parsed from pointref.

survey_project.description: Pls/Cad/Cadm project, normalised to Xxx-NNN[-L]. Empty where none.

barrio.description: Barrio name parsed from 'Bo. of X'. Source spelling preserved.

prs92_lat.description: Latitude as published. PRS92 geographic, EPSG:4683.

prs92_lon.description: Longitude as published. PRS92 geographic, EPSG:4683.

wgs84_lat.description: Latitude transformed to WGS84, EPSG:4326. Use for imagery.

wgs84_lon.description: Longitude transformed to WGS84, EPSG:4326. Use for imagery.

ptm_zone.description: Philippine Transverse Mercator zone. 4 throughout this release.

ptm_east.description: Easting as published, EPSG:3124. Passed through, never recomputed.

ptm_north.description: Northing as published, EPSG:3124. Passed through, never recomputed.

ptm_check_resid_m.description: Distance between recomputed and published grid position. QA field.

dataset_version.description: Semantic version of this dataset release.

legal_status.description: Standing caveat carried on every record.
